biggest_catch: You only get paid if you win an audition AND the terms pay out: per-finished-hour rates are negotiated per project with no official floor, and Royalty Share pays $0 unless the audiobook actually sells — returns even reduce the net units you are paid on.
catches: Per-finished-hour rate is agreed with each rights holder; ACX publishes no minimum PFH rate, so the official terms do not fix your pay.
Royalty Share (20% legacy / 25% new of royalties) pays nothing unless the title sells; customer returns within 7 days reduce net sales units.
Royalties below $50 in an accounting period are carried forward by Audible, not paid out.
You must deliver ACX-spec audio and pass quality review (review within 10 business days); rework costs you time, and rights holders may request two full rounds of changes.
Royalty Share distribution runs for the term of the Book Posting Agreement (exclusive); the voice-replica model pays a smaller share (10% legacy / 12.5% new) over a 7-year distribution period.
Editing/mastering costs (your time or a hired engineer) come out of whatever you earn.

c1.evidence: ACX (Audiobook Creation Exchange) — real operating Audible/Amazon platform; official Help Center royalty and producer-checklist articles.

c2.evidence: Official 'How royalties work' (help.acx.com): Royalty Share — producer (narrator) receives an equal share: 20% (legacy) or 25% (new) of royalties from Audible/Amazon/Apple Books sales. Pay-for-Production — one-time per-finished-hour payment, rate agreed with the rights holder. Royalty Share Plus — reduced upfront PFH + royalty split.

steps: Go to the official ACX site and create a producer (narrator) profile.
Browse posted projects and audition for titles that fit your voice.

When a rights holder offers you the project, agree on terms: a per-finished-hour fee (Pay-for-Production), a royalty share (20% legacy / 25% new of audiobook royalties), or Royalty Share Plus (reduced upfront PFH + royalty split).
Record and master the audiobook to ACX audio specifications; the rights holder may request up to two full rounds of changes.
After rights-holder approval and ACX quality review (within 10 business days), get paid per your agreement — upfront for PFH, monthly via electronic payment from Audible for royalty share.
timing: PFH paid on delivery/approval per the rights-holder agreement; royalty-share payments monthly via electronic payment from Audible (amounts under $50 carried forward).

maximize: Prefer PFH contracts for upfront cash, audition for short books (<3 hours) to get paid sooner, and deliver clean audio on the first submission to skip revision delays.
